T-059 is blocked: the first-lines script is built and committed (9907805), but the Tantra test campaign isn't built because there's no Tantra API key on this machine. Adi needs to create one in Tantra under Settings > API Keys and save it at `~/.config/tantra/tantra-api-key`. Then run `first_lines.py tantra-test` to build the test campaign.

- **What I checked:** On 3 made-up sample leads, `workshop-plan/scripts/first_lines.py` produced 3 lines out of 3, with no dashes. The A/B split and the reply-rate tracker also ran correctly.
- **Template field:** I didn't have the Tantra backend to read, so I took the field syntax from the live reminder funnel. It fills contact fields as `{{custom.first_line}}`, so no per-contact body workaround is needed.
- **Not done:** I didn't push, because the worktree holds other lanes' uncommitted changes and a push sends the whole main branch. The real and control batches wait for T-056's list and go out with T-058.
